description: ZONES D'EXPANSION DE CRUE POTENTIELLES DES BASSINS VERSANTS DE LA SARTHE AMONT ET DE L'HUISNE is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. POTENTIAL CRUE EXPANSION AREAS The identification of potential flood expansion zones was carried out by IDEA Recherche, Asconit Consultants and Hydratec, in 2004 for Huisne and in 2007 for Sarthe Amont. They were delineated from a multi-criteria analysis under Geographic Information System, based on criteria such as hydrology, geology, land cover, geomorphology, etc. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "POTENTIAL CRUE EXPANSION AREAS FOR BASSINS VERSANTS OF SARTHE AMONT AND HUISNE" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include sarthe, huisne, inondation, crue, zone inondable. The listing shows 2007-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
